name: apt
purpose: Advanced Package Tool — Debian/Ubuntu Linux package manager for installing and updating CLI software.
syntax: sudo apt update && sudo apt install <package>
explanation: Downloads, verifies, resolves dependencies for, and installs command-line software packages on Ubuntu and Debian-based Linux systems (including WSL).

parameters.description: Refreshes the local index of available package versions from repositories.
Automatically answers yes to confirmation prompts.

example: sudo apt update && sudo apt install ffmpeg qrencode
expectedOutput:
Reading package lists... Done
Building dependency tree... Done
The following NEW packages will be installed:
  ffmpeg qrencode
whenToUse: When installing tools like `gcc`, `ffmpeg`, or `qrencode` on Ubuntu Linux or WSL.
commonMistakes: Running `apt install` without `sudo`, or forgetting `apt update` on a fresh container/VM.
platformCompatibility: Ubuntu / Debian GNU/Linux & WSL (use `brew` on macOS)
explanationOfOutput: Refreshes package metadata and lists new packages and dependencies about to be installed.
commonErrors: E: Could not open lock file /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend - open (13: Permission denied) — forgot `sudo`
